awards.title: 1-Day Django Workshop in Pumpjack Dataworks
awards.description:
We successfully wrapped up an insightful workshop on Django Development Framework at Pumpjack Dataworks, conducted for my fellow colleagues.

The objective of the session was to build a practical understanding of Django, moving beyond basic concepts and exploring how the framework is structured and used to develop real-world web applications.

We started with a walkthrough of a typical Django project layout, breaking down its directory structure, key files, application organization, and the responsibilities of different components. From there, we explored Django's request-response lifecycle, views and their different types, URL routing, and how these components work together to handle application logic.

We also spent time understanding Django's ORM (Object-Relational Mapper), exploring how models represent database structures, how queries are executed through the ORM, and how Django simplifies database integration without requiring developers to write raw SQL for every operation.

Other areas covered included:

- Django project and application architecture.
- Understanding the purpose of important files and directories.
- Function-based and class-based views.
- URL routing and request handling.
- Models, migrations, and database integration.
- Working with Django ORM and database queries.
- Application configuration and environment-specific settings.
- Deployment considerations and production configuration.

Rather than simply going through documentation or theoretical concepts, we focused on understanding how the pieces fit together, why Django follows a particular structure, and how these concepts translate into actual development workflows.

Overall, it was a productive and engaging session with plenty of opportunities for discussion, knowledge sharing, and technical exploration.

A big thank you to everyone who participated and contributed to making the workshop worthwhile. It's always rewarding to share knowledge, exchange ideas, and grow together as engineers.

education.description:
I was part of various extracurricular activities and societies including **IEEE Computer Society - Karachi Section** and **Arts & Culture Society**, while also maintaining my academic record of being among the toppers of Masters Program. I studied under state of the art teachers and developed several educational projects related to Computer Science which really proved to be an enlightening experience.
I am glad that I worked on my Final Year Project under Dr. Asim Ali and **won a prize in the CodeBIT Competition** held by Department of Computer Science on March 2022, which was primarily sponsored by WANZ International Enterprize, Qavi Technologies and many other industries.
My Final Year Project was based on Data Analytics and Business Intelligence, where I was aggregating Freelancer's Data from various sources through an ETL pipeline and displayed insights in a web application.

I proved to be a diligent student and earned recognitions from my Professor Dr. Khurram Iqbal. My skills in Python Programming Language & MS Excel Spread Sheets were recognized as worthy of being nominated as a Teacher's Assisstant (working under Dr. Khurram Iqbal) for conducting lab sessions for the student's of Financial Mathematics.
During my Bachelors, I was also engaged in some educational group projects related to Statistics, and Robotics as part of my studies. I worked on MS Excel, Python and Arduino Microprocessors. My other subjects were highly theoretical in mathematical applications.
I also became a member of **Arts & Culture Society**, a student's club founded by University Alumni and patronized by Dr. Asim Ali and supervised by Dr. Khalid Iraqi (VC University of Karachi). In this Club I took part in activities related to literature review, event planning and promotion and as an IT support.
